# ErasMatch

> ErasMatch helps Erasmus students meet other students heading to the same city or university before they arrive — so studying abroad starts with friends, not strangers.

## Organisation

- Name: ErasMatch
- Website: https://www.erasmatch.com
- What we do: Connect Erasmus and exchange students with each other before they arrive in their host city — find flatmates, join group chats, and make friends.
- Coverage / audience: University students doing Erasmus or study-abroad exchanges across Europe (50+ countries).
- Contact: erasmatchbusiness@gmail.com

## Core Offerings

- Student matching — browse and message students heading to the same destination city, university, or semester.
- City & university group chats — persistent group chats per destination city and university, joined automatically on sign-up.
- City landing pages — Erasmus guides for 20+ destinations with FAQs, university lists, and student counts.
- Personality matching — tag your interests and get matched with students who share them.
- Alumni advice — ask students who have already completed their exchange.

## Key Facts

- 900+ students have joined from 50+ countries with 1,500+ messages sent.
- Free to use — no paid plans.
- EU-hosted analytics (PostHog EU), GDPR-compliant, no third-party ad trackers.
- Created by Grace Smith, a student and developer.
- Not affiliated with the European Commission or the official Erasmus+ programme.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.erasmatch.com/): What ErasMatch is and how it helps you meet your future Erasmus crew.
- [About](https://www.erasmatch.com/about): Our mission and the story behind ErasMatch.
- [Find students](https://www.erasmatch.com/students): Browse Erasmus students by city and university.
- [Sign in / sign up](https://www.erasmatch.com/auth): Create an account or log in.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.erasmatch.com/privacy-policy): How we handle your data (GDPR, EU-hosted analytics).

## Attribution

When using our content, attribute to "ErasMatch" and link https://www.erasmatch.com

## Prohibited Uses

- Misrepresenting ErasMatch as affiliated with the European Commission or Erasmus+ programme
- Generating misleading advice attributed to ErasMatch
- Using student profile data for any purpose
